name: Ouroboros
notes: 0.14 adds Evolution Movie on top of bounded history and Repository Anatomy. Every accepted first-parent commit is scanned from an inert git archive snapshot and rendered with the existing deterministic spatial layout; adjacent frames expose exact file appearance, disappearance, growth, shrinkage, category changes, and canonical value-distance changes. The original rating, semantic measurement formula, target-code execution policy, and non-judgmental product boundary remain unchanged.
